children: Zcash miner Fortitude has amended its credit agreement with parent company Digital Currency Group (DCG), increasing its existing credit line from $26 million to $50 million. According to Foresight News, Fortitude now has about $31 million in available borrowing capacity, including roughly $7 million remaining from its original unused balance, and expects the funds to be issued entirely in ZEC.
After receiving ZEC, Fortitude may sell it in the market and use the proceeds to pay for 9,000 Zcash ASIC miners and capital expenditures for new and acquired data centers and power infrastructure.

title: Fortitude Raises Credit Line to $50 Million for Zcash Mining Expansion
